description: Soft-cancel a watch immediately: no new events accrue, but the event log stays READABLE via x402_watch_events until the original expires_at (cancel is not a delete). Probing drops back to normal cadence as soon as no active watches cover the endpoint. Bearer-authed with the secret from x402_watch_create. Free and idempotent.

secret.description: The one-time bearer secret returned by x402_watch_create.

name: x402_watch_cancel
title: x402 watch — cancel early (free)
